notes: Key rooms on (WMOID, WMOGroupID); AreaTableID is 0 for many rooms (BRD) — do not join AreaTable first.
bbox is world/creature space (MID−internal after spawn transform) matching pack-clusters centroids.
Packs whose centroid falls in no room are listed under unassigned — never snapped to nearest.
Zul'Farrak and other terrain-only maps legitimately have zero named WMO rooms.
namedGroupRows counts WMOAreaTable rows carrying an AreaName; 0 of a non-zero wmoAreaRows means 1.12 names no sub-room here, not that the join broke (dungeon-done.mjs F2).
